SEC. 10214. APPROPRIATIONS.

    There is authorized to be appropriated, and there are appropriated, 
$25,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2010 through 2019, to carry out 
this part.

                PART III--INDIAN HEALTH CARE IMPROVEMENT
